 Presented by Buccaneers-Panthers Injury Report Oct.23: Egbuka, Goedeke and Winfield Jr. Ruled Out; Mayfield Questionable
 A look at Friday's injury report ahead of the Week Seven matchup
 Oct 23, 2026 at 12:59 PM Brianna Dix Staff Writer/Reporter
 Copied! 
 On Friday for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot),  Luke Goedeke (calf) and Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib) were ruled out. Additionally, Baker Mayfield (right thumb) was listed as questionable.
 DNP: Did Not Participate
 FP: Full Participation
 LP: Limited Participation
 Read below for the full injury report for both teams:
 Buccaneers
 P Riley Dixon (illness) - FP (Wed.), FP (Thurs.), FP (Friday)
 WR Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) - DNP (Wed.), DNP (Thurs.), LP (Friday) Game Status: Out 
 WR Chris Godwin Jr. (rest) - DNP (Thurs.), FP (Friday)
 T Luke Goedeke (calf) - DNP (Wed.), DNP (Thurs.),  LP (Friday) Game Status: Out 
 RB Bucky Irving (illness) - DNP (Wed.), LP (Thurs.), FP (Friday)
 DT Calijah Kancey (illness) - LP (Wed.), FP (Thurs.), FP (Friday)
 G Cody Mauch (wrist) - FP (Wed.), FP (Thurs.), FP (Friday)
 QB Baker Mayfield (right thumb) - FP (Wed.), FP (Thurs.), FP (Friday) Game Status: Questionable 
 CB Zyon McCollum (illness) - DNP (Wed.), LP (Thurs.), FP (Friday)
 K Chase McLaughlin (illness) -  FP (Wed.), FP (Thurs.), FP (Friday)
 CB Benjamin Morrison (quad) -  FP (Wed.), FP (Thurs.), FP (Friday)
 DL A'Shawn Robinson (rest) -  LP (Thurs.), FP (Friday)
 LB Christian Rozeboom (finger) - DNP (Wed.), DNP (Thurs.)
 WR David Sills V (hamstring) - FP (Wed.),  FP (Thurs.), FP (Friday)
 LB Josiah Trotter (shoulder) -  FP (Wed.),  FP (Thurs.), FP (Friday)
 RB Sean Tucker (quad) -  FP (Wed.),  FP (Thurs.), FP (Friday)
 NT Vita Vea (rest) - LP (Wed.),  FP (Thurs.), FP (Friday)
 S Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib) - LP (Wed.), LP (Thurs.),  LP (Friday) Game Status: Out 
 Panthers 
 RB A.J. Dillon (ankle) - FP (Wed.), FP (Thurs.), FP (Friday)
 T Monroe Freeling (knee) - FP (Wed.), FP (Thurs.), FP (Friday) Game Status: Questionable 
 RB Chuba Hubbard (rest) - DNP (Wed.), FP (Thurs.), FP (Friday)
 OLB Thomas Incoom (calf) - DNP (Wed.),  DNP (Thurs.), DNP (Friday) Game Status: Out 
 LB Devin Lloyd (rest) - DNP (Wed.), FP (Thurs.), FP (Friday)
 LB Bam Martin-Scott (hamstring) - FP (Wed.), FP (Thurs.),  FP (Friday) Game Status: Questionable 
 T Taylor Moton (rest) - DNP (Wed.), FP (Thurs.), FP (Friday)
 OLB Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) - DNP (Wed.),  DNP (Thurs.), DNP (Friday) Game Status: Out 
 TE Darren Waller (rest) - DNP (Wed.),  FP (Thurs.), FP (Friday)
 QB Bryce Young (knee) - FP (Wed.),  FP (Thurs.), FP (Friday)
